title: BioinfoIPBLN/reanatax pipeline - params.db_input schema
description: Schema for the genome sheet given with --db_input under --build_databases: one row per genome

id.errorMessage: id must be given and use only letters, digits, '-' and single '_' (not '__', which the builds use as a separator): it names the genome's files, and sylph-tax matches genomes by file name

taxid.errorMessage: taxid must be a positive NCBI taxonomy id: every sequence of the genome is assigned to it

fasta.errorMessage: fasta must be an existing FASTA (.fa, .fasta, .fna or .fas, optionally gzipped) without spaces in its name

accession.errorMessage: accession must be an NCBI assembly accession (GCF_* or GCA_*), downloaded with ncbi-genome-download

cds.errorMessage: cds, if given, must be an existing nucleotide FASTA of the genome's coding sequences (.fa, .fasta, .fna, .ffn or .fas, optionally gzipped)
